hard_rules: Paid-product queries may not be assigned to the free Builder
Every authority route must have one paid-product owner
Primary commercial CTA must include price
Supporting pages must link to the paid landing page before the free Builder
host_rules: The root path on weddingchecklistpdf.com is the Dream Wedding Builder parent hub
The paid Checklist authority destination remains /products/checklist-pdf on the same host
Checklist commercial queries must resolve to /products/checklist-pdf, not the root free-builder hub
The root hub may route users to all four paid destinations but may not own their commercial queries
